<thought>Using the ESI‑MS spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 194.0862, which corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈ 193.079 Da. The formula that best matches this exact mass with only C, H, and O atoms is C₁₁H₁₃O₃.</thought>
<final_answer>C11H13O3</final_answer>
